authority.mask: original learned-path eligible pairs/index>0/window, inherited unchanged
authority.probe_subset: nonzero only first original Walk (node1 stand->walk); every other callback returns0
authority.scope_limit: Later residual actions cannot repair the first Walk strict failure; finite first-window profiles do not cover all continuous admissible action sequences
authority.velocity_basis: body command inputs to frozen locomotion controller

controls: same-reference residual-off current replay checked exactly against retained Phase3A.4b
learned-injection-path zero callback checked for exact commands/physics/metrics
evidence: all raw result rows including failures
20Hz state archives and exact final pose (acquisition samples, no media)

additional_requirements: final absolute commanded-axis lateral not worse
final absolute wrapped commanded-heading error not worse
global_claim.metric: final commanded-world Euclidean endpoint error strictly lower than its alpha0.5 residual-off baseline
global_claim.not_claimed: all-prefix or all-component Pareto improvement; no new historical global success threshold
required_disclosure: full final XY vector including any X regression
per-node world vector/norm/head, including prefix tradeoff

protocol.local_claim: STRICT endpoint eligibility on all original nodes; nominal independent secondary report; not continuous/environmental corridor safety
protocol.origin: actual node start; frozen selector unchanged
protocol.physical_claim: original complete physical success, finite/valid execution and all original nodes SUCCESS; report status/fall/tilt/height separately
preserved: original observation and dense_reward callback path; reward ignored, never tuned
node boundaries/targets/skill lifecycle and all envelopes

process_limits.failure: retain completed/partial evidence and stop; never retry unfavorable outcomes
process_limits.progress: one run completion plus ledger/trace growth

protocol.question: Can the current bounded 2s residual authority construct a strict-eligible physically complete 16m behavior with same-reference world-accuracy gain?
protocol.reference_choice: fixed retained challenge, not alpha optimization
protocol.roundoff_role: arithmetic verification only, not a task threshold; paired gains within this resolution cannot establish FEASIBLE
protocol.schedule_and_stop: Off then zero; integrity must pass before probes. Execute predeclared profiles in order until a qualifying joint witness; repeat first witness and stop if exact. If none qualify, repeat combined_inward for deterministic negative verification and stop. No resampling or profile tuning.
protocol.stopping_boundary: No PPO/Phase3A.5, reward tuning, best alpha, authority/window extension or Console expansion

verdict_rules.FEASIBLE: At least one deterministic profile and its exact confirmation satisfy all frozen strict, complete physical and declared paired-global conditions.
verdict_rules.INCONCLUSIVE: No repeated joint witness and no full-space certificate; retain probed failures and measured window/authority effects without training expansion.
verdict_rules.NOT_FEASIBLE: Only with a validated reachability/invariant bound covering the entire admissible continuous authority or mutually incompatible required hard goals; saturation/failed probes/command integrals are not such proof.
